entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Seriously? Geez, now I feel[n]like I'm fallin' behind.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I feel that, man. But we've got[n]hearts to change out there.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All this reminds me of goin' around[n]the school lookin' for witnesses.[n]Remember?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: With the whole volleyball rally[n]thing? Both of us runnin' around[n]trying to get dirt on Kamoshida?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Feels the same as it ever was.[n]I guess it's always like this, but...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Point is, I'm counting on you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm gonna get out there and[n]get our info! See ya!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ryuji's really dedicated to this, huh?[n]Then we gotta keep up too!
